game.title: Assassin's Creed Origins
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG set in Ptolemaic Egypt, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2017-10-27. RAWG average playtime: 28 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Bayek's quest across Egypt, from the first steps to the end. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Exploring Egypt
chapters.summary: Locations, tombs, hermits, Stone Circles, papyrus mysteries, underwater sites, viewpoints, vehicles and photos.

chapters.title: Arena and Hippodrome
chapters.summary: The Krokodilopolis Arena events, arena bosses, the war elephants and Hippodrome races.

chapters.title: Combat, Stealth and Wildlife
chapters.summary: Multi-kills, the predator bow, stealth streaks, Phylakes, lions, predators and crocodiles.

chapters.title: Levels, Abilities and Gear
chapters.summary: Levelling up, Master abilities, Legendary gear, crafting and selling trinkets.

chapters.title: The Hidden Ones (DLC)
chapters.summary: The Hidden Ones expansion: Arsinoe, the rebels and the Walls-of-the-Ruler citadel.

chapters.title: The Curse of the Pharaohs (DLC)
chapters.summary: The Curse of the Pharaohs expansion: mummies, the Serqet locations, the Afterlifes and Shards of a Star.

chapters.title: Guided Tours
chapters.summary: Completing the educational tours, including the Daily Life category.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 582160)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Assassin's_Creed_Origins
Fandom (assassinscreed.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://assassinscreed.fandom.com/wiki/Assassin's_Creed:_Origins
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; its only subpage is the Table of Contents (about 5,500 characters), with no walkthrough pages written, so no structure was taken. assassinscreed.fandom.com answers the API under "Assassin's Creed: Origins", with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 23 of 67 Steam achievements are hidden. The 11 listed first ("First Steps" to "The End") look like story beats. "Surgical Strikes", "New Recruits" and "The Greater Good" sit inside The Hidden Ones block and "Lift the Curse" inside The Curse of the Pharaohs block, so they were placed there by schema position, which needs checking. The other 8 hidden ones ("Seven Farmers", "The Festival", "Smash!", "Where's My Black Flag?", "Free as a Bird", "Triathlete", "Run For Your Life!", "Namaste") sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder; most are probably side content. The DLC names come from the bracketed tags in the descriptions and from RAWG entries. The three tour achievements carry no DLC tag; the data does not name the tour mode.
